/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit
from solution import patch_query

def check(url, updates, expected):
    result = urlsplit(patch_query(url, updates))
    original = urlsplit(url)
    assert (result.scheme, result.netloc, result.path, result.fragment) == (original.scheme, original.netloc, original.path, original.fragment)
    assert parse_qsl(result.query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, result

check('https://user@example.invalid:81/p%20x?a=1&b=&a=2&c=3#frag%20x', [], [('a','1'),('b',''),('a','2'),('c','3')])
check('/p?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=&A=4#frag', iter([('a','x'),('b',None),('a',''),('missing',None)]), [('c',''),('A','4'),('a','')])
check('?%61=1&a=2&A=3&x+y=4&x%2By=5', [('a','6'),('x y',None)], [('A','3'),('x+y','5'),('a','6')])
updates = [('雪 +&%=', 'café 雪 +&%=') , ('', '')]
before = updates.copy()
check('../p?stay=1#f', (pair for pair in updates), [('stay','1')] + updates)
assert updates == before
check('//example.invalid/p?x&x=&=blank#f', [], [('x',''),('x',''),('','blank')])
check('/p?a=1', [('a',None),('a','2'),('a',None)], [])
check('/p#f', [('new','')], [('new','')])
print('7 additional cases passed: preservation, duplicates/blanks, sequential updates, decoded case-sensitive keys, literal encoding, generator input, and deletion.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- solution.py && git status --short'
